title: graph weight euclidean distance
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkGraphWeightEuclideanDistanceFilter by creating a simple undirected graph with 4 vertices and 3 edges, computing edge weights based on Euclidean distance, and rendering the graph layout.

**dataset → input → filter → layout → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkGraphLayout](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphLayout.html) — graph layout filter.
- [vtkGraphToPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphToPolyData.html) — converts graph to polydata.
- [vtkGraphWeightEuclideanDistanceFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphWeightEuclideanDistanceFilter.html) — graph weight euclidean distance filter.
- [vtkLabeledDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLabeledDataMapper.html) — labeled data mapper.
- [vtkMutableUndirectedGraph](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMutableUndirectedGraph.html) — mutable undirected graph.
- [vtkPoints](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPoints.html) — stores 3D point coordinates.
- [vtkVertexGlyphFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkVertexGlyphFilter.html) — vertex glyph filter.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
